command:
set -eu
cfg=/etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/10-key-only-auth.conf
[ ! -e "$cfg" ] || { printf '%s\n' "refusing to overwrite existing $cfg"; exit 1; }
tmp=$(mktemp /tmp/sshd-key-only.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
printf '%s\n' 'PubkeyAuthentication yes' 'PasswordAuthentication no' 'KbdInteractiveAuthentication no' 'AuthenticationMethods publickey' > "$tmp"
chmod 0600 "$tmp"
/usr/sbin/sshd -t -f "$tmp"
install -o root -g root -m 0600 "$tmp" "$cfg"
restorecon "$cfg"
if ! /usr/sbin/sshd -t; then
  rm -f "$cfg"
  printf '%s\n' 'candidate rejected and removed'

command:
set -eu
auth=/home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
tmpdir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/opsadmin-ssh-test.XXXXXX)
case "$tmpdir" in /tmp/opsadmin-ssh-test.*) ;; *) printf '%s\n' 'unsafe temp path'; exit 1 ;; esac
cp -p "$auth" "$tmpdir/authorized_keys.original"
cleanup() {
  cp -p "$tmpdir/authorized_keys.original" "$auth"
  chown opsadmin:opsadmin "$auth"
  chmod 0600 "$auth"
  restorecon "$auth"
  rm -rf "$tmpdir"
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
ssh-keygen -q -t rsa -b 2048 -N '' -C opsadmin-runtime-verification -f "$tmpdir/test_rsa"
cat "$tmpdir/test_rsa.pub" >> "$auth"
chown opsadmin:opsadmin "$auth"
chmod 0600 "$auth"
result=$(ssh -i "$tmpdir/test_rsa" -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o UserKnownHostsFile="$tmpdir/known_hosts" -o ConnectTimeout=10 opsadmin@"$NODE_IP" 'printf "user=%s shell=%s\n" "$(id -un)" "$SHELL"; id')
printf '%s\n' '--- rsa public-key login result ---' "$result"
printf '%s\n' "$result" | grep -F 'user=opsadmin shell=/bin/bash' >/dev/null
cleanup
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
printf '%s\n' '--- final requested-key fingerprint after test cleanup ---'
ssh-keygen -l -E sha256 -f "$auth"
test "$(wc -l < "$auth")" -eq 1
